dataset.title: Fare Zones
dataset.description:
This layer provides a geographic representation of the fare zones used by Auckland Transport to calculate public transport fares. The polygons depict the spatial extent of each fare zone and are intended to support mapping and visualisation of the fare zone system.

For information about fare zones and fare calculations, visit the Auckland Transport Bus and Train Fares page.

Update Cycle: Currently this is a static dataset, any changes are manually loaded when they occur.

dataset.title: Future Connect Integrated Network
dataset.description:
This open data is provided for reference. The primary and recommended way to view Future Connect, with additional Transport System Analysis and other insights (not shared as open data), is through the Future Connect Mapping Portal.

Description

The Future Connect Integrated Network layer represents a long-term, multi-modal view of the region’s most important transport corridors and connections. Comprised of both the Current (existing) and First Decade (longer-term) views of Auckland’s transport network, it brings together the Strategic Networks for all transport modes — public transport, general traffic, freight, and cycling — into a single, cohesive spatial dataset. This layer also includes the lower order, Supporting Network links for all modes.

Intended Use

  • Transport planning and prioritisation
  • Identifying key corridors for operational management
  • Supporting RLTP investment decisions
  • Land‑use and development integration

Limitations

  • Does not define or commit to specific projects.
  • Not a detailed engineering or operational dataset.
  • Represents strategic priorities at a regional scale. 

For more information, visit AT.govt.nz/FutureConnect.

dataset.title: Cycle Facility Network
dataset.description:
The Cycle Facility Network Map data viewable and downloadable here, shows the location of cycle facilities of all types across Auckland. This is a comprehensive view of the current built network and consists of cycle facilities provided by Auckland Transport, NZTA and Auckland Council.

 
This data feeds into the publicly available on the Auckland Cycleway Map. This map shows cycle routes across the city and is provided to help you plan your rides. The map highlights the different types of infrastructure on each of the routes and shows on-road cycles lanes, on-road protected cycle lanes, shared paths and quiet routes.
 
Cycleways form part of our future strategic network called The Cycle and Micromobility Strategic Network, which is made up of the most important corridors that link to key destinations. 
 

More details about the future strategic cycling and micromobility network and how it links to other modes is available at Future Connect- Auckland Transport's Network Plan.

dataset.title: Mooring Locations
dataset.description: Current map shows locations of moorings managed by Auckland Harbourmaster. All attribute and location information is pulled from moorings database sitting on Auckland Transport infrastructure. Mooring sites are located within Mooring Management Areas throughout the Auckland region. Auckland Transport (AT) grants an annual mooring licence to boat owners, allowing occupancy of a mooring (annual fees apply). There are 70 Mooring Management Areas (MMA) where mooring is permitted in the Auckland region. The Harbourmaster's office administers mooring areas to ensure that the space is used most effectively and the boats are suitably positioned within the areas.
